verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a free tier or free trial for Elicit. The pricing-page snippets ('Unlimited search', 'Unlimited chat with papers') are not tied to any free plan. The reference to features available 'regardless of which Elicit plan you subscribe to' only implies that tiers exist, not that any of them is free or that a trial is offered.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can try the product meaningfully on a free tier or trial
